title: Build-ready dashboard requirements spec
objective: Measure whether the dashboard-spec craftbook scopes audience decisions and writes a build-ready metrics/dashboard spec instead of designing chart salad.
prompt: In the `Dashboard Spec Eval` project, read `source/dashboard-brief.md` and write `dashboard-spec.md` for a support operations dashboard. It must define audience, decisions, five questions, widgets/charts, metric definitions, filters, refresh cadence, visual hierarchy, and acceptance criteria. Do not build the dashboard.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the dashboard-spec craftbook. Requirements are in workspace/source/dashboard-brief.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a build-ready dashboard specification with audience, decisions, questions, widgets, metric definitions, filters, refresh cadence, hierarchy, and acceptance criteria.

files.content:
# Support Operations Dashboard Brief

Audience: support director and queue leads.
Decisions: staffing for Monday backlog, escalation coaching, and carrier status messaging.
Signals available: ticket volume by queue, first response time, reopen rate, SLA breaches, carrier scan delay count, premium subscriber duplicate tickets, agent capacity, and weekly exception export status.
Refresh: hourly during business hours, daily summary at 17:00.
Filters: queue, region, carrier, customer segment, agent team, date range.
